picks.reasoning: GEN's individual talent, especially Chovy in mid, outclasses IG, and the 2026 LCK form backs that up over the LPL side's 18-25 series record. IG's hype around IGRookie and their comeback history doesn't change that a single game still favors the stronger players.

Tempo is all about first towers and dragons, and GEN takes towers 65% of the time to IG's 40% with a +0.6k lead at 15, so they own the early map. IG has the clutch comeback threat, but I'm not betting on a late reset when GEN's first objectives keep the pace on their side.

Drafting this one, GEN's mid pool (Ryze 5, Syndra 3, Akali 2) and Chovy's form give them the stronger Fearless read, and they convert leads at a high rate while IG's 18-25 LPL record shows a shakier pick-and-execute baseline. IG's comeback tendency keeps this from being a lock, so I'm not pushing past the high 60s.

GEN's 37-10 series record against IG's 18-25 and their 5-1 mark against other regions point to GEN, but the last-10 form is close (8-2 vs 7-3) and IG's 1-game sample gap is modest, so I'm not leaning hard. The 20-game GD@15 and objective numbers are nearly even, which keeps this a moderate pick.

Both sides carry a lot of the same numbers, but I read the mood differently: GEN has shown they stay together when they fall behind, with comebacks from -6.7k and -4.8k and zero throws, while IG threw a 5.3k lead at TES and their calm depends on leads holding. I'm backing GEN's steadier group chemistry, though IG's ability to flip games makes this closer than the record suggests.
